name: reply_style_open_web
description: Operator reply instructions must reach the prompt even when the facts came from the sender's own link rather than pinned knowledge pages. They used to be gated on pinned knowledge, so the setting was silently ignored in the commonest case of all.

message.body:

What is the price of this machine? https://example.com/lathe-9000

We would need two units before the end of the quarter.

Thanks,
Dana
